title: Jewel-like Peruvian Rocoto Relleno
description: A comforting Peruvian dish featuring raisins and nimono-simmer, all wrapped up in a crispy rocoto pepper shell.

ingredients.name: Medium rocoto peppers
ingredients.notes: Any type of sweet pepper can be used as substitute.

ingredients.name: Raisins
ingredients.notes: Soaked in warm water for 10 minutes.

instructions: Heat the oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until translucent, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for another minute.
Soak the raisins in warm water for 10 minutes, then drain and set aside.
Cut off the tops of the rocoto peppers and remove the seeds and membranes.
Fill each pepper with a mixture of butter, breadcrumbs, cheese, cilantro, salt, and black pepper.
Place the stuffed peppers in the skillet and baste with water.
Transfer the skillet to the oven and bake at 375°F for 20-25 minutes, or until the peppers are tender and the filling is golden brown.
Serve warm, garnished with additional cilantro if desired.
